question: For the original 1,585-position median-cap portfolio, could the large exits fit into the recorded exchange turnover?
selection: For the fee-only actual native fill ledger, group child exits and compulsory trims by symbol and native hour. Inspect the 20 largest summed market-open exits, the 20 largest total exit hours with an intrahour or close fill, and the last actual market exit of each of the 10 largest realized winning parents. Historical outcome selects diagnostics only, never positions. Absolute underlying USDT paid/received comes from the original signed cash before fees. Exclude administrative/delisting settlement fills; report exclusions.
test: Require official 60-minute OHLC to aggregate to the exact frozen H1 and quote/base turnover to be consistent with real traded prices. Compare same-clock opening exit total with the first observed minute turnover, and total market exit notional with the entire observed H1. If the portfolio requested more than all observed exchange turnover, that modeled execution could not fit that period. A smaller share does not establish liquidity at its modeled price or accessible book depth. Missing and conflicting data stay unknown. Do not trade or re-price the account.
